frontend-release.reason: Only tauapi-fe/VERSION changes; FER-5 defines VERSION as the local-build fallback and build-frontend.sh reads it at the candidate. Asset prefix, manifest, deploy/rollback and FER-6 no-checksum archive rules are unchanged.

validation.objective: Publish frontend-only TauAPI v1.1.1 on GitHub Releases from main: bump tauapi-fe/VERSION to 1.1.1 (tauapi-be/VERSION stays 1.1.0 by user decision), build the frontend archive and manifest from the committed candidate, and publish a Simplified Chinese change-only release without SHA256 content.
acceptance: tauapi-fe/VERSION is 1.1.1 and tauapi-be/VERSION is 1.1.0 at the tagged candidate; the annotated v1.1.1 tag points at it on origin.
The frontend archive is built from the candidate subtree only and contains no SHA256 files or metadata or test sources.
The release body is Simplified Chinese and lists only changes.
The public release feed exposes v1.1.1 as latest with exactly the frontend archive and manifest.
validation.notes: Frontend-only release by user decision: the admin update notice compares the backend version (1.1.0) with the latest tag, so it will report v1.1.1 as available until a backend 1.1.1 is released. Production deployment is out of scope.

next_action: Commit the version bump, build the frontend from the candidate, push main and tag v1.1.1, publish the release.
